scope: Fail closed when media usage inspection reaches its recursion-depth bound, so retention cannot rely on an incomplete reference scan.

finding.reproduction: A saved page model contained the target asset ID below 16 nested objects. The usage endpoint returned complete=true with an empty reference list, and the retention request could therefore treat an uninspected document as unused.
finding.fix: assetPaths accepts a per-document scan status and marks it incomplete when a nested object crosses the bounded depth. mediaUsage propagates this to usage.complete; no guessed reference path is returned.
finding.safety_effect: The existing retentionRequest complete-usage guard responds 409 / USAGE_INCOMPLETE. The regression asserts that no retention request row is inserted and the local R2 fixture object remains present.
